item.caption: VARICELLA IGG ANTIBODY QUANTITATIVE - Final result (08/07/2024 8:15 AM PDT)

content.content:
<135.0 Index = Negative
=>135.0 - <165.0 Index = Equivocal (A second sample should be collected).
=>165.0 Index = Positive
Presence of detectable VZV IgG antibodies. A positive result generally
indicates exposure to the pathogen or administration of specific
immune-globulins, but it is no indication of active infection or stage of
disease.

item.caption: VARICELLA IGG ANTIBODY, BLOOD (VARICELLA IGG ANTIBODY (ELISA), BLOOD) - Final result (08/07/2024 8:15 AM PDT)

content.content:
This test uses an FDA-approved indirect
chemiluminescence assay (CLIA) for the
qualitative detection of IgG antibodies
specific to Varicella Zoster virus (VZV).

item.caption: RUBELLA IGG ANTIBODY QUANTITATIVE - Final result (08/07/2024 8:15 AM PDT)

content.content:
<0.90 Index = Negative
=>0.90- <1.0 Index = Equivocal (A second sample should be collected).
=>1.00 Index = Positive
Sample is considered positive for IgG antibodies to rubella virus.

item.caption: MEASLES IGG ANTIBODY QUANTITATIVE - Final result (08/07/2024 8:15 AM PDT)

content.content:
<13.5 AU/mL = Negative
=>13.5 - <16.5 AU/mL = Equivocal (A second sample should be collected no
less than one or two weeks later).
=>16.5 AU/mL = Positive
Presence of detectable measles virus IgG antibodies. A positive result
generally indicates past exposure to measles virus or previous vaccination.
